title: Two dice: the 36 outcomes by total
caption: Of the 36 equally likely outcomes, 6 have total 7, so P(7) = 6/36 = 1/6 and P(not 7) = 5/6. No other total is as likely.
alt: Bar chart of the number of the 36 outcomes giving each total from 2 to 12: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1; the bar for 7 is highlighted.
description: Each of the 6 × 6 = 36 outcomes of two dice has a total from 2 to 12.
The bar heights count how many outcomes give each total.
Total 7 has the tallest bar: 6 outcomes, so P = 6/36 = 1/6.
